title: Artifact for "Two Fixed-Seat Paths to Payload Orphaning in ePBS"
description:
Reproducibility artifact for the paper. Contains a spec-anchored simulator port of the Ethereum ePBS (EIP-7732 / gloas) payment, settlement, payload-timeliness and fork-choice paths; the experiments cited by the paper; a 293-test differential suite against the executable pyspec, 206 of whose tests execute the generated gloas spec and which sweeps the 0-512 seat count exhaustively to pin the 257/256 boundary; and a bundled 935,314-block panel of MEV-Boost delivered payloads (2026-02-21 to 2026-07-10) built from the eight relays' proposer_payload_delivered records and cross-checked two independent ways, so the economic figures reproduce with no external download.

Entry point: docs/PAPER3_ARTIFACT_README.md maps each claim to the command that reproduces it. bash experiments/reproduce_paper3.sh regenerates every headline result in one invocation. docs/DISCLOSURE.md records the report made to the specification authors (ethereum/consensus-specs issue #5516) and the response.

Pinned consensus-specs snapshot: 5366cb59e (2026-08-05).
